The zeta-potential values of 50 nm PS-NH2 and 1 μm PS-NH2 were +24.13 ± 0.660 and -33.97 ± 0.447 mV, respectively. || The hydrodynamic diameter (Z-average), polydispersity index (PDI), and zeta potential were measured as key parameters describing PS-NH2 behavior in ultrapure water. || Measurements were carried out in triplicate. || characterized using dynamic light scattering (DLS) (Malvern Zetasizer Nano ZS90, Malvern Instruments Ltd., Malvern, UK)
